sections.sectionText: This is an introductory course for freshman and transfer students who are new to the University of Illinois. Students will discover what Illinois’ top actuarial program has to offer and how to navigate their time on campus as well as their time post-graduation. This course also teaches students useful professional skills such as resume building, interview prep, and recruiting strategies. It also offers students career advice and discusses the different paths to becoming an actuary.

sections.sectionText: Students must have an internship lined up before requesting permission for this course and must submit a report to the instructor at the end of the term. International students should request permission by completing the CPT e-form from ISSS, selecting the ASRM 398 instructor as advisor, and then emailing the instructor with 9-digit UIN and ASRM 398 request if ISSS approves the CPT. Those without a student visa may contact the instructor directly.

sections.sectionText: The course will provide an introduction to the foundation and industry trends of financial and insurance technology. It offers an overview of the FinTech and InsurTech ecosystems, various innovations in digital banking, trading and insurance. The course provides elementary reviews of technical foundations, such as "big data", textual analysis, blockchain, cryptocurrencies and disruptive business models. If time permits, regulatory challenges in FinTech and InsurTech shall be also discussed.
